flows.title: Send an RPC request with retry
flows.intent: Retry RpcClient::send on timeout with exponential backoff and give up with Exhausted; entry points: mempool::broadcast_tx, wallet::send_payment and every other caller of send.

flows.title: Default timeout 30 s → 5 s
flows.intent: Shorten the default per-request timeout in RpcConfig::default; reached through RpcClient::new.

flows.title: New error variant RpcError::Exhausted
flows.intent: Add RpcError::Exhausted, returned by send after the last attempt; reached by every match on RpcError.

flows.title: Removed the single-attempt API send_once()
flows.intent: Remove RpcClient::send_once; callers that must not retry have to use send.

flows.title: Move of backoff helpers util/backoff.rs → rpc/retry.rs
flows.intent: Move the delay helpers next to RetryPolicy and change the jitter constant; reached through RetryPolicy::backoff.

unassigned.reason: Adds a metrics helper that nothing in this pull request calls.
